_comment: ALTERNATE compiler profile: clang 4.0.1 + -mllvm -pre-RA-sched=source. This is the corrected pin candidate (see AGENTS.md -> 'Compiler pin revision: clang 4.0.1'). It reproduces the reference instruction selection that 5.0.1 structurally cannot: BFC for a BIC-encodable bitfield clear, predication of a small if-block, and the original load/zero scheduling. Evidence: the four previously-unmatchable probes (613d733c, 60553a4c, 60082510, 6122c168) all byte-match under 4.0.1, and the 2,376-function matched corpus re-gates to 2,354 matches (99.1%) under this profile -- far better than the 2,220 (93.4%) the earlier -disable-ifcvt-simple variant scored. The 22 residual regressions (10 body-length, 12 mismatch) are 4.0.1-vs-reference if-conversion/scheduling heuristic differences and are documented in AGENTS.md. This is now the project default — see `config/toolchain.json`. This file is kept as a legacy alias for anything that still references it by name.
